claim: In the feature availability by resource table, Amazon DynamoDB (without the AWS Backup advanced features) has check marks only for AWS Backup Audit Manager and restore testing, and no check mark for cross-Region backup, cross-account backup, incremental backup, continuous backup and point-in-time restore, full management, lifecycle to cold storage or logically air-gapped vault.
question: Which AWS Backup features does DynamoDB support without the advanced features?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon DynamoDB without advanced features in the feature availability by resource table
qualifiers.condition: a blank cell means no check mark in the table
